rationale: Select both left- and right-seeded KCg-d five-contact operational groups before any selection-language loss. They retain every literal KCg-d seed on its selected side, include annotated partners, and provide two complete within-size comparisons at 487 and 540 neurons. Their visual-KC motivation comes from the prior pathway audit; neither is an intact circuit. Both are the lowest-cost complete group pair in the measured catalog. Three thousand shared updates permit a first controlled selection and topology screen across all 128 fits within a 72-hour training planning allowance, instead of selecting individual favorable controls. The shorter exposure limits claims about convergence and must not be compared as an equal-budget replacement for the 12000-update BabyLM baselines. Further exposure, olfactory-seeded groups and one-contact sensitivity remain later registered studies.
